source.text: Τρίτον τοῦτο ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς· ἐπὶ στόματος δύο μαρτύρων καὶ τριῶν σταθήσεται πᾶν ῥῆμα.

records.literal_gloss: Third this [time] I am coming to you; upon [the] mouth of two witnesses and three will be established every matter.

en.L: This third [time] I am coming to you. On [the] mouth of two witnesses and of three every matter will be established.
en.B: I am now coming to you for the third time. "Every charge is to be settled on what two or three witnesses say."
en.R: I am about to visit you for the third time. God's law says that a charge against someone must be proved by two or three witnesses.

fr.L: Cette troisième [fois] je viens chez vous. Sur la bouche de deux témoins et de trois, toute affaire sera établie.
fr.B: Je viens maintenant chez vous pour la troisième fois. « Toute accusation sera réglée sur la déclaration de deux ou trois témoins. »
fr.R: Je vais bientôt venir vous voir pour la troisième fois. La Loi de Dieu dit qu’une accusation contre quelqu’un doit être prouvée par deux ou trois témoins.

es.L: Esta [es la] tercera [vez que] voy a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Por boca de dos testigos y de tres se establecerá todo asunto.
es.B: Ahora voy a {{plural_you:visitarlos|visitaros}} por tercera vez. «Toda acusación se ha de resolver por lo que digan dos o tres testigos».
es.R: Estoy por {{plural_you:visitarlos|visitaros}} por tercera vez. La ley de Dios dice que una acusación contra alguien debe probarse con dos o tres testigos.

sw.L: Hii ni mara ya tatu ninakuja kwenu. Kwa kinywa cha mashahidi wawili na watatu kila jambo litasimamishwa.
sw.B: Sasa ninakuja kwenu kwa mara ya tatu. "Kila shtaka litaamuliwa kwa ushahidi wa watu wawili au watatu."
sw.R: Ninakaribia kuja kuwatembelea kwa mara ya tatu. Sheria ya Mungu inasema kwamba shtaka dhidi ya mtu lazima lithibitishwe na mashahidi wawili au watatu.

vi.L: Đây là lần thứ ba tôi đến với anh chị em. Mọi việc sẽ được xác lập theo lời của hai hoặc ba nhân chứng.
vi.B: Bây giờ tôi sắp đến với anh chị em lần thứ ba. "Mọi lời cáo buộc phải được giải quyết dựa trên lời của hai hoặc ba nhân chứng."
vi.R: Tôi sắp đến thăm anh chị em lần thứ ba. Luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời nói rằng một lời cáo buộc ai phải được chứng minh bởi hai hoặc ba nhân chứng.

ko.L: 이번이 세 번째로 내가 여러분에게 가는 것입니다. 두 증인이나 세 증인의 입으로 모든 일이 확정될 것입니다.
ko.B: 나는 이제 세 번째로 여러분에게 갑니다. "모든 고발은 두세 증인의 말로 확정되어야 한다."
ko.R: 나는 곧 세 번째로 여러분을 찾아갑니다. 하나님의 율법은 어떤 사람을 고발할 때 두세 증인이 있어야 그것이 사실로 증명된다고 말합니다.

pt.L: Esta terceira [vez] vou até vocês. Pela boca de duas testemunhas e de três toda questão será confirmada.
pt.B: Agora vou até vocês pela terceira vez. "Toda acusação deve ser decidida pelo que disserem duas ou três testemunhas."
pt.R: Logo vou visitar vocês pela terceira vez. A Lei de Deus diz que uma acusação contra alguém precisa ser provada por duas ou três testemunhas.

am.L: ይህ ወደ እናንተ የምመጣበት ሦስተኛው [ጊዜ] ነው። በሁለትና በሦስት ምስክሮች አፍ ነገር ሁሉ ይጸናል።
am.B: አሁን ለሦስተኛ ጊዜ ወደ እናንተ እመጣለሁ። «ክስ ሁሉ የሚጸናው ሁለት ወይም ሦስት ምስክሮች በሚሰጡት ቃል ነው።»
am.R: ለሦስተኛ ጊዜ ልጎበኛችሁ ነው። የእግዚአብሔር ሕግ በአንድ ሰው ላይ የሚቀርብ ክስ በሁለት ወይም በሦስት ምስክሮች መረጋገጥ እንዳለበት ይናገራል።

decisions.choice: Paul's third visit to Corinth, which is about to happen
alternatives: a third attempt or plan to come, with only one visit so far
decisions.reason: Paul first came to found the church (Acts 18:1-11). 2:1 speaks of a painful visit, and 12:14 says he is ready to come "this third time", so he had been there twice already. The present tense ἔρχομαι ("I am coming") speaks of a visit that is close at hand, as often with this verb.

decisions.choice: a quotation of the rule in Deuteronomy 19:15
decisions.reason: The words follow the Greek Old Testament of Deuteronomy 19:15 closely: in Israel no one could be found guilty on the word of a single witness. Jesus applies the same rule in Matthew 18:16, and it is used for charges against church leaders in 1 Timothy 5:19. Paul does not introduce it as a quotation, but his readers would know it.

decisions.choice: two or three witnesses: at least two
decisions.reason: "Two witnesses and three" is the Hebrew way of saying "two or three". The point is that more than one witness is needed.

decisions.choice: Paul will deal with wrongdoing at his visit by a proper hearing, in which every charge must be backed by witnesses
alternatives: Paul's own warnings are the witnesses: his second visit, this letter and his coming visit add up to two or three testimonies
decisions.reason: The quotation can be read in two ways. Paul may mean that on his visit any charge against members of the church will be judged fairly, with evidence (12:20-21). Or he may count his own visits and warnings as the witnesses, which would fit verse 2, where he says he warned them on his second visit and warns them again now. The words themselves are about a legal hearing, so we take that sense, but the second view is possible and the two can go together.

decisions.choice: I am now coming to you for the third time
alternatives: this is the third time I am coming to you
decisions.reason: Balanced puts "third time" at the end of the clause, where English puts the emphasis that the Greek gives it by placing it first.

decisions.choice: quotation marks (B); God's law says (R)
decisions.reason: The words are a quotation (m2). Balanced marks it with quotation marks; Readable names where it comes from, since young readers will not recognize it.

decisions.choice: charge (B); a charge against someone (R)
decisions.reason: ῥῆμα can mean "word" or "matter"; in Deuteronomy 19:15 it is the matter being tried, a charge. Literal keeps "matter".

decisions.choice: La Loi de Dieu dit
decisions.reason: The quoted rule is from the Law of Moses (Deuteronomy 19:15), so French writes "la Loi" with a capital, as the style guide sets for the Law.

decisions.choice: shtaka
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the rule as a proper hearing of charges, so Balanced and Readable say "shtaka" (a charge in court); Literal keeps the general "jambo" (matter).

decisions.choice: no quotation marks (L); quotation marks (B); "Luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời nói rằng" (R)
decisions.reason: A quotation of Deuteronomy 19:15 (m2), marked as the English marks it.

decisions.choice: "theo lời của hai hoặc ba nhân chứng" (L); "lời cáo buộc" (B, R) for rhema here
alternatives: "bởi miệng hai hoặc ba người làm chứng"
decisions.reason: At least two witnesses (m3), in a proper hearing of each charge (m4, uncertain). Literal says "theo lời", the plain sense of "on the mouth of".

decisions.choice: The quotation of Deuteronomy 19:15 in the plain style (B, "확정되어야 한다")
decisions.reason: Quotations of Scripture are in 해라체; Literal has no quotation marks, as the English Literal does not, and keeps the letter's style.

decisions.choice: "두 증인이나 세 증인" (L); "두세 증인" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "two witnesses and three" as the Hebrew way of saying "two or three".
The meaning decision reads the matter as a charge to be backed by witnesses at Paul's visit.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the reader's setting that capitalises pronouns for God and Christ has nothing to change in Amharic; the pronouns (እርሱ, the verb endings) are written once, with no span, throughout this chapter.

source.text: προείρηκα καὶ προλέγω ὡς παρὼν τὸ δεύτερον καὶ ἀπὼν νῦν, τοῖς προημαρτηκόσιν καὶ τοῖς λοιποῖς πᾶσιν, ὅτι ἐὰν ἔλθω εἰς τὸ πάλιν οὐ φείσομαι, ἐπεὶ δοκιμὴν ζητεῖτε τοῦ ἐν ἐμοὶ λαλοῦντος Χριστοῦ· ὃς εἰς ὑμᾶς οὐκ ἀσθενεῖ ἀλλὰ δυνατεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν, καὶ γὰρ ἐσταυρώθη ἐξ ἀσθενείας, ἀλλὰ ζῇ ἐκ δυνάμεως θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: I have said before and I say beforehand, as being present the second [time] and being absent now, to those having sinned before and to the rest all, that if I come to the again I will not spare, \v 3 since proof you seek of the in me speaking Christ, who toward you not is weak but is powerful among you; \v 4 for indeed he was crucified out of weakness, but he lives out of power of God.

en.L: I have said before, and I say beforehand, as [I did when] present the second [time] and [as I do] now [while] absent, to those who sinned before and to all the rest, that if I come again I will not spare [anyone], \v 3 since you seek proof of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} who speaks in me, who is not weak toward you but is powerful among you; \v 4 for indeed {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was crucified out of weakness, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lives by [the] power of God.
en.B: When I was with you on my second visit, I gave a warning to those who had sinned before and to all the rest, and now, while I am away, I give it again: when I come back I will spare no one, \v 3 since you are asking for evidence that {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} really speaks in me. He does not deal with you in weakness; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is powerful among you. \v 4 He was indeed crucified in weakness, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lives by the power of God.
en.R: When I visited you the second time, I warned those who had sinned before, and everyone else too. Now that I am away, I am warning them again: when I come back, I will not go easy on anyone. \v 3 I will do this because you want proof that {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} speaks through me. You will see that {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is not weak in the way {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} treats you. He uses {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power among you. \v 4 It is true that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was weak when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was put to death on the cross. But now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lives by God's power.

fr.L: J’ai dit auparavant et je dis d’avance, comme [lorsque j’étais] présent la deuxième [fois] et [comme je le fais] maintenant [que je suis] absent, à ceux qui ont péché auparavant et à tous les autres, que si je viens de nouveau, je n’épargnerai [personne], \v 3 puisque vous cherchez une preuve du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} qui parle en moi, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui n’est pas faible envers vous, mais qui est puissant parmi vous ; \v 4 car en effet {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été crucifié par faiblesse, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vit par la puissance de Dieu.
fr.B: Lors de ma deuxième visite, j’ai averti ceux qui avaient péché auparavant, et tous les autres aussi ; et maintenant que je suis absent, je les avertis de nouveau : quand je reviendrai, je n’épargnerai personne, \v 3 puisque vous demandez une preuve que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} parle vraiment en moi. Il n’est pas faible avec vous ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est puissant parmi vous. \v 4 Il a été crucifié, certes, dans la faiblesse, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vit par la puissance de Dieu.
fr.R: Quand je suis venu vous voir la deuxième fois, j’ai averti ceux qui avaient péché auparavant, et aussi tous les autres. Maintenant que je suis loin, je les avertis de nouveau : quand je reviendrai, je ne serai indulgent avec personne. \v 3 Je le ferai parce que vous voulez une preuve que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} parle par moi. Vous verrez que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} n’est pas faible dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} manière de vous traiter. Il utilise {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance parmi vous. \v 4 C’est vrai, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été faible quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été mis à mort sur la croix. Mais maintenant, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vit par la puissance de Dieu.

es.L: He dicho antes y digo de antemano, como estando presente la segunda [vez] y estando ausente ahora, a los que antes pecaron y a todos los demás, que si voy otra vez no tendré consideración [con nadie], \v 3 ya que {{plural_you:buscan|buscáis}} una prueba del {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} que habla en mí, el cual no es débil para con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, sino que es poderoso entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; \v 4 porque, en efecto, fue crucificado por debilidad, pero vive por [el] poder de Dios.
es.B: Cuando estuve con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en mi segunda visita, advertí a los que habían pecado antes y a todos los demás, y ahora, estando lejos, lo vuelvo a advertir: cuando vuelva, no tendré consideración con nadie, \v 3 ya que {{plural_you:piden|pedís}} pruebas de que {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} habla de verdad por medio de mí. Él no es débil en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trato con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, sino que es poderoso entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. \v 4 Es cierto que fue crucificado en debilidad, pero vive por el poder de Dios.
es.R: Cuando {{plural_you:los|os}} visité por segunda vez, advertí a los que habían pecado antes, y también a todos los demás. Ahora que estoy lejos, les vuelvo a advertir: cuando vuelva, no seré blando con nadie. \v 3 Lo haré porque {{plural_you:quieren|queréis}} pruebas de que {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} habla por medio de mí. {{plural_you:Verán|Veréis}} que {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} no es débil en la manera en que {{plural_you:los|os}} trata. Él usa {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. \v 4 Es verdad que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} era débil cuando {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} mataron en la cruz. Pero ahora vive por el poder de Dios.

sw.L: Nimesema kabla, na ninasema mapema, kama [nilivyofanya] nilipokuwapo mara ya pili, na sasa [nikiwa] mbali, kwa wale waliotenda dhambi hapo kwanza na kwa wengine wote, kwamba nikija tena sitamhurumia [mtu yeyote], \v 3 kwa kuwa mnatafuta uthibitisho wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} anayesema ndani yangu, ambaye si dhaifu kwenu bali ana nguvu kati yenu; \v 4 kwa maana kweli alisulubiwa kutokana na udhaifu, lakini anaishi kwa nguvu ya Mungu.
sw.B: Nilipokuwa pamoja nanyi katika ziara yangu ya pili, niliwaonya wale waliotenda dhambi hapo kwanza na wengine wote, na sasa, nikiwa mbali, ninawaonya tena: nitakaporudi sitamhurumia mtu yeyote, \v 3 kwa kuwa mnataka ushahidi kwamba kweli {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} anasema ndani yangu. Hashughuliki nanyi kwa udhaifu; ana nguvu kati yenu. \v 4 Ni kweli alisulubiwa katika udhaifu, lakini anaishi kwa nguvu ya Mungu.
sw.R: Nilipowatembelea mara ya pili, niliwaonya wale waliotenda dhambi hapo kwanza, na kila mtu mwingine pia. Sasa kwa kuwa niko mbali, ninawaonya tena: nitakaporudi, sitamwachilia mtu yeyote. \v 3 Nitafanya hivyo kwa sababu mnataka uthibitisho kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} anasema kupitia kwangu. Mtaona kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} si dhaifu katika jinsi anavyowatendea. Anatumia nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kati yenu. \v 4 Ni kweli kwamba alikuwa dhaifu alipouawa msalabani. Lakini sasa anaishi kwa nguvu ya Mungu.

vi.L: Tôi đã nói trước, và tôi nói trước [một lần nữa], như [khi tôi] có mặt lần thứ hai và [như tôi nói] bây giờ [khi] vắng mặt, với những người đã phạm tội trước đây và với tất cả những người còn lại, rằng nếu tôi lại đến, tôi sẽ không dung thứ [ai], \v 3 vì anh chị em tìm bằng chứng về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} là Đấng nói trong tôi, là Đấng không yếu đuối đối với anh chị em nhưng có quyền năng giữa anh chị em; \v 4 vì thật vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã bị đóng đinh trên thập tự giá bởi sự yếu đuối, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống bởi quyền năng của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Khi tôi ở với anh chị em trong lần thăm thứ hai, tôi đã cảnh cáo những người đã phạm tội trước đây và tất cả những người còn lại, và bây giờ, trong khi vắng mặt, tôi cảnh cáo lần nữa: khi tôi trở lại, tôi sẽ không dung thứ cho ai cả, \v 3 vì anh chị em đang đòi bằng chứng rằng {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} thật sự nói qua tôi. Ngài không yếu đuối khi đối xử với anh chị em; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có quyền năng giữa anh chị em. \v 4 Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã bị đóng đinh trên thập tự giá trong sự yếu đuối, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống bởi quyền năng của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Khi đến thăm anh chị em lần thứ hai, tôi đã cảnh cáo những người đã phạm tội trước đây, và cả mọi người khác nữa. Bây giờ, khi đang ở xa, tôi cảnh cáo họ lần nữa: khi tôi trở lại, tôi sẽ không nương tay với ai cả. \v 3 Tôi sẽ làm như vậy vì anh chị em muốn có bằng chứng rằng {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} nói qua tôi. Anh chị em sẽ thấy {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} không yếu đuối trong cách {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đối xử với anh chị em. Ngài dùng quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữa anh chị em. \v 4 Đúng là {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã yếu đuối khi bị đóng đinh trên thập tự giá. Nhưng bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống bởi quyền năng của Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 내가 두 번째로 [여러분과] 함께 있을 때 전에 말한 것처럼, 지금 떠나 있으면서도 전에 죄를 지은 사람들과 나머지 모든 사람에게 미리 말합니다. 내가 다시 가면 [아무도] 용서하지 않을 것입니다. \v 3 여러분이 내 안에서 말씀하시는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 증거를 구하기 때문입니다. 그분은 여러분을 향해 약하지 않으시고 여러분 가운데서 능력이 있으십니다. \v 4 참으로 그분은 약함으로 십자가에 못 박히셨지만, 하나님의 능력으로 살아 계십니다.
ko.B: 내가 두 번째로 여러분을 찾아갔을 때, 전에 죄를 지은 사람들과 나머지 모든 사람에게 경고했습니다. 그리고 지금 떠나 있으면서 다시 경고합니다. 내가 다시 가면 아무도 봐주지 않을 것입니다. \v 3 여러분이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 정말로 내 안에서 말씀하신다는 증거를 찾고 있기 때문입니다. 그분은 여러분을 약하게 대하지 않으시고, 여러분 가운데서 능력을 나타내십니다. \v 4 그분은 참으로 약한 가운데 십자가에 못 박히셨지만, 하나님의 능력으로 살아 계십니다.
ko.R: 내가 두 번째로 여러분을 찾아갔을 때, 나는 전에 죄를 지은 사람들과 다른 모든 사람에게 경고했습니다. 지금은 떠나 있지만, 나는 그들에게 다시 경고합니다. 내가 다시 가면, 나는 누구도 봐주지 않을 것입니다. \v 3 내가 그렇게 하려는 것은 여러분이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 나를 통해 말씀하신다는 증거를 원하기 때문입니다. 여러분은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 여러분을 대하실 때 약하지 않으시다는 것을 보게 될 것입니다. 그분은 여러분 가운데서 그분의 능력을 쓰십니다. \v 4 그분이 십자가에서 죽임을 당하셨을 때 약하셨던 것은 사실입니다. 그러나 지금 그분은 하나님의 능력으로 살아 계십니다.

pt.L: Eu já disse antes e digo de antemão, como [quando estive] presente pela segunda [vez] e agora [estando] ausente, aos que pecaram antes e a todos os demais, que, se eu for de novo, não pouparei [ninguém], \v 3 já que vocês buscam prova do {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} que fala em mim, que não é fraco para com vocês, mas é poderoso entre vocês; \v 4 pois de fato {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi crucificado pela fraqueza, mas {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vive pelo poder de Deus.
pt.B: Quando estive com vocês na minha segunda visita, dei um aviso aos que tinham pecado antes e a todos os outros, e agora, enquanto estou longe, eu o repito: quando eu voltar, não vou poupar ninguém, \v 3 já que vocês estão pedindo provas de que {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} realmente fala em mim. Ele não trata vocês com fraqueza; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é poderoso entre vocês. \v 4 De fato, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi crucificado em fraqueza, mas {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vive pelo poder de Deus.
pt.R: Quando visitei vocês pela segunda vez, avisei os que tinham pecado antes, e também todos os outros. Agora que estou longe, estou avisando outra vez: quando eu voltar, não vou ser brando com ninguém. \v 3 Vou agir assim porque vocês querem uma prova de que {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} fala por meio de mim. Vocês vão ver que {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} não é fraco na maneira como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} trata vocês. Ele usa o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder entre vocês. \v 4 É verdade que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} estava fraco quando foi morto na cruz. Mas agora {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vive pelo poder de Deus.

am.L: አስቀድሜ ተናግሬአለሁ፤ አስቀድሜም እናገራለሁ፤ ሁለተኛ ጊዜ በዚያ ሳለሁ [እንደ ተናገርኩ]፣ አሁንም ርቄ ሳለሁ፣ ቀድሞ ኃጢአት ለሠሩትና ለቀሩት ሁሉ፤ ይኸውም እንደ ገና ብመጣ [ማንንም] እንደማልምር ነው፤ \v 3 {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} በእኔ እንደሚናገር ማስረጃ ትፈልጋላችሁና፤ እርሱ ለእናንተ ደካማ አይደለም፤ በመካከላችሁ ግን ብርቱ ነው፤ \v 4 በእርግጥም ከድካም የተነሣ ተሰቀለ፤ ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ኃይል ሕያው ነው።
am.B: በሁለተኛው ጉብኝቴ ከእናንተ ጋር በነበርኩ ጊዜ ቀድሞ ኃጢአት ለሠሩትና ለሌሎቹ ሁሉ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥቼ ነበር፤ አሁንም ርቄ ሳለሁ እንደ ገና አስጠነቅቃለሁ፤ ተመልሼ ስመጣ ማንንም አልምርም፤ \v 3 ይህም {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} በእውነት በእኔ እንደሚናገር ማስረጃ ስለምትፈልጉ ነው። እርሱ ከእናንተ ጋር በድካም አይሠራም፤ በመካከላችሁ ብርቱ ነው። \v 4 በእርግጥ በድካም ተሰቅሏል፤ ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ኃይል ሕያው ነው።
am.R: ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ ስጎበኛችሁ፣ ቀድሞ ኃጢአት የሠሩትን ሌሎቹንም ሁሉ አስጠንቅቄ ነበር። አሁን ርቄ ሳለሁ እንደ ገና አስጠነቅቃቸዋለሁ፤ ተመልሼ ስመጣ ለማንም አልራራም። \v 3 ይህን የማደርገው {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} በእኔ በኩል እንደሚናገር ማረጋገጫ ስለምትፈልጉ ነው። {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} እናንተን በሚይዝበት መንገድ ደካማ እንዳልሆነ ታያላችሁ። ኃይሉን በመካከላችሁ ይጠቀማል። \v 4 በመስቀል ላይ ሲሞት ደካማ እንደ ነበረ እውነት ነው። አሁን ግን በእግዚአብሔር ኃይል ሕያው ነው።

decisions.choice: two moments: Paul warned them when he was present on his second visit, and warns them again now that he is absent
alternatives: "as if I were present a second time, though I am absent now"
decisions.reason: The two participles παρὼν ("being present") and ἀπὼν ("being absent") match the two verbs: "I have said before" goes with his presence on the second visit, "I say beforehand" with his absence now. The second visit is the painful one of 2:1.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: no verb "I write" after "now"
alternatives: "and being absent now I write to those who sinned before"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "I write" here, as the King James Version has it. The SBLGNT reading, without it, is supported by early manuscripts; the added word makes explicit what the sentence already implies. Reviewers must check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: those who had sinned before: members who had sinned and not repented before Paul's second visit; the rest are everyone else in the church
decisions.reason: The same verb προαμαρτάνω is used in 12:21, where Paul fears he will have to grieve over many who sinned before and have not repented of their impurity and sexual sin. The warning is for them first, and also for all the others.

decisions.choice: the reason Paul will not spare them: they want proof that Christ speaks through him, and his firmness will give it
alternatives: the clause begins a new thought that runs on to verse 5
decisions.reason: ἐπεὶ ("since") links back to "I will not spare". Some in Corinth doubted that Christ really spoke through Paul, because he seemed weak in person (10:10). If he must act firmly on his visit, they will have their proof.

decisions.choice: proof: evidence produced by testing
decisions.reason: δοκιμὴν is the quality that a test brings to light (2:9; 8:2). It begins a run of words from the same family in verses 3-7: "test" (verse 5), "pass the test" (verse 7) and "fail the test" (verses 5, 6, 7). The Corinthians want to test Paul; he will turn the test back on them (verse 5).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "for indeed he was crucified"
alternatives: "for even if he was crucified" (adding the word for "if")
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "if", making the clause concessive, "for even though he was crucified". The SBLGNT text, without it, states the fact directly. The sense is much the same. Reviewers must check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: Christ was crucified in weakness and now lives by God's power; the same pattern marks Paul's ministry
alternatives: he was crucified because of weakness, as if weakness were the cause of his death
decisions.reason: ἐξ ἀσθενείας ("out of weakness") describes the state in which Christ died: he let himself be weak and was put to death. ἐκ δυνάμεως θεοῦ ("out of God's power") names the source of his risen life (Romans 6:4). This is the pattern of 12:9-10, where Christ's power is made perfect in weakness, and of 4:10-11. Paul's weakness does not disprove that Christ speaks through him; it matches the way Christ himself went to the cross.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}
decisions.reason: Pronouns for Christ take the deity_pronoun setting; at the start of a sentence "He" is capitalized either way.

decisions.choice: [anyone] (L); spare no one (B); not go easy on anyone (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb has no object. English needs one; the sense is that no one who has sinned will be let off.

decisions.choice: crucified in weakness (B); was weak when he was put to death on the cross (R)
decisions.reason: "Out of weakness" is not natural English. Balanced and Readable say that Christ was weak when he died (m7). Literal keeps the preposition.

decisions.choice: I will do this because ...; You will see that
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence, repeats what the "since" goes back to, Paul's firmness on his visit, and says that this will be the proof they asked for (m4).

decisions.choice: une preuve
decisions.reason: The word is evidence produced by testing (m5). "Preuve" shares its root with "épreuve", the word used for the test in verses 5-7 ("mettez-vous à l’épreuve", "échouer à l’épreuve"), so the family of words stays visible in French.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui
decisions.reason: French Literal resumes the relative clause with a stressed pronoun for Christ, which carries the span; the English has a bare "who".

decisions.choice: no tendré consideración con nadie
decisions.reason: As in 1:23, "perdonar" would suggest forgiving; the sense is that Paul will not hold back from discipline (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} (R) only
decisions.reason: The English has spans on "he" and "his". Swahili carries "he" inside the verbs ("alisulubiwa", "anaishi"), which cannot take a capital, so only the possessive "zake" at Readable takes the span.

decisions.choice: uthibitisho
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "uthibitisho" (proof), from the root used for this word family in 2:9, 9:13 and 10:18, which runs on into verses 5-7.

decisions.choice: "không dung thứ [ai]" (L); "không dung thứ cho ai cả" (B); "không nương tay với ai cả" (R) for ou pheisomai
decisions.reason: As in 1:23, where Paul came no more to Corinth "to spare" them.

decisions.choice: "bằng chứng" for dokime here
decisions.reason: Evidence produced by testing (m5); the dokimos family runs on into 13:5-7, where "được chấp nhận" and "bị loại" carry it.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} for Christ mid-sentence; a capital "Ngài" with no span where it starts a sentence
decisions.reason: The book-wide rule for deity pronouns: a sentence start is capitalized anyway, so the span would change nothing.

decisions.choice: "bị đóng đinh trên thập tự giá bởi sự yếu đuối" (L); "trong sự yếu đuối" (B); "đã yếu đuối khi bị đóng đinh" (R)
decisions.reason: Christ crucified in weakness and living by God's power, the pattern of Paul's ministry (m7).

decisions.choice: "용서하지 않다" (L); "봐주지 않다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to spare; Korean "용서하지 않다" (L) keeps the sense of not holding back punishment, and "봐주다" is the plain word.

decisions.choice: Christ takes the honorific ("말씀하시는", "약하지 않으시고", "못 박히셨지만", "살아 계십니다")
decisions.reason: The project's rule for Christ; Korean has no deity_pronoun span (docs/korean-style.md).

decisions.choice: "약함으로 십자가에 못 박히셨지만" (L); "약한 가운데" (B); "약하셨던 것" (R)
decisions.reason: Follows the SBLGNT "for indeed he was crucified", without "if"; the meaning decision reads the clause as Christ crucified in weakness.

decisions.choice: "증거" (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as evidence produced by testing, the first of a run of testing words in verses 3-7.

decisions.choice: pela fraqueza ... pelo poder
decisions.reason: Literal repeats the same preposition, as the Greek does, so that weakness and power stand side by side as the two sources (m7). "Por causa da fraqueza" would say that weakness caused the crucifixion; Balanced says "em fraqueza", the state in which he died.

decisions.choice: prova
decisions.reason: "Prova" in Portuguese means both a test and the proof a test gives, so it begins the family Paul builds in verses 3-7: "prova", "pôr à prova", "aprovados", "reprovados" (m5).

decisions.choice: ማስረጃ (L, B); ማረጋገጫ (R) for 'proof'
alternatives: a form of ፈተና (test), to match ፈተናውን ያለፈ / የወደቀ in verses 5–7
decisions.reason: The word is the evidence that testing brings out. Amharic has no natural noun of ፈተነ for 'the proof that results', so it says ማስረጃ (evidence); the testing family is kept visible with ፈተነ in verses 5–7.

source.text: καὶ γὰρ ἡμεῖς ἀσθενοῦμεν ἐν αὐτῷ, ἀλλὰ ζήσομεν σὺν αὐτῷ ἐκ δυνάμεως θεοῦ εἰς ὑμᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: And for we are weak in him, but we will live with him out of power of God toward you.

en.L: For we too are weak in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, but we will live with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} by [the] power of God toward you.
en.B: We too are weak in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, but you will find us living with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} by the power of God.
en.R: We are weak too, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was, because we belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. But when we come to you, you will see that we live with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} by God's power.

fr.L: Car nous aussi, nous sommes faibles en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, mais nous vivrons avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} par la puissance de Dieu envers vous.
fr.B: Nous aussi, nous sommes faibles en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, mais vous verrez que nous vivons avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} par la puissance de Dieu.
fr.R: Nous aussi, nous sommes faibles, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a été, parce que nous {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartenons. Mais quand nous viendrons chez vous, vous verrez que nous vivons avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} par la puissance de Dieu.

es.L: Porque también nosotros somos débiles en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, pero viviremos con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} por [el] poder de Dios para con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: También nosotros somos débiles en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, pero {{plural_you:verán|veréis}} que vivimos con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} por el poder de Dios.
es.R: Nosotros también somos débiles, como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo fue, porque {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenecemos. Pero cuando vayamos a {{plural_you:verlos|veros}}, {{plural_you:verán|veréis}} que vivimos con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} por el poder de Dios.

sw.L: Kwa maana sisi nasi tu dhaifu ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, lakini tutaishi pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} kwa nguvu ya Mungu kwenu.
sw.B: Sisi nasi ni dhaifu ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, lakini mtatuona tukiishi pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} kwa nguvu ya Mungu.
sw.R: Sisi pia ni dhaifu, kama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alivyokuwa, kwa sababu sisi ni {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Lakini tutakapokuja kwenu, mtaona kwamba tunaishi pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} kwa nguvu ya Mungu.

vi.L: Vì chúng tôi cũng yếu đuối trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nhưng chúng tôi sẽ sống với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bởi quyền năng của Đức Chúa Trời đối với anh chị em.
vi.B: Chúng tôi cũng yếu đuối trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nhưng anh chị em sẽ thấy chúng tôi sống với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bởi quyền năng của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Chúng tôi cũng yếu đuối như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã yếu đuối, vì chúng tôi thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Nhưng khi chúng tôi đến với anh chị em, anh chị em sẽ thấy chúng tôi sống với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bởi quyền năng của Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 우리도 그분 안에서 약하지만, 여러분을 향해서는 하나님의 능력으로 그분과 함께 살 것입니다.
ko.B: 우리도 그분 안에서 약합니다. 그러나 여러분은 우리가 하나님의 능력으로 그분과 함께 살아 있는 것을 보게 될 것입니다.

decisions.choice: weak in him: sharing Christ's weakness because Paul is joined to him
alternatives: weak in the way he was weak, as an example only
decisions.reason: "In him" is Paul's language for being united with Christ. Because he belongs to the crucified Christ, he shares the weakness of the cross (4:10; Philippians 3:10).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "weak in him"
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts read "with him" in the first clause, matching "we will live with him" in the second. The SBLGNT reads "in him"; the change to "with" could easily come from the clause that follows. Reviewers must check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: we will live with him toward you: Paul will show Christ's risen power in his dealings with the Corinthians when he comes
alternatives: the future resurrection life of believers
decisions.reason: The future "we will live" could point to the resurrection at the end. But εἰς ὑμᾶς ("toward you") ties it to Paul's coming visit: the Corinthians will see God's power at work in him, as verse 3 promised.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}
decisions.reason: Pronouns for Christ.

decisions.choice: you will find us (B); when we come to you, you will see (R)
decisions.reason: "Toward you" says that the Corinthians are the ones who will meet this power (m3). Balanced and Readable make that a clause about what they will find.

decisions.choice: as he was, because we belong to him
decisions.reason: Readable explains "in him" (m1) and links Paul's weakness to Christ's in verse 4.

decisions.choice: "yếu đuối trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}" (L, B); "sống với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ... đối với anh chị em" (L)
decisions.reason: Sharing Christ's weakness because joined to him (m1); Christ's risen power shown in Paul's dealings with them (m3).

decisions.choice: "그분 안에서" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Follows the SBLGNT "in him", as the meaning decision sets it.

decisions.choice: "여러분을 향해서는 ... 살 것입니다" (L); "여러분은 ... 보게 될 것입니다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "we will live with him toward you" as Christ's risen power shown in Paul's dealings with them when he comes.

decisions.reason: Portuguese contracts "em" and "ele" into "nele"; the whole word goes under the setting, and only its first letter changes.

records.literal_gloss: Yourselves probe whether you are in the faith, yourselves test; or not do you recognize yourselves that Jesus Christ [is] in you?

en.L: Probe yourselves, whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Or do you not recognize about yourselves that Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} [is] in you?
en.B: Look closely at yourselves: are you holding to the faith? Put yourselves to the test. Or do you not see in your own lives that Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is in you?
en.R: Look hard at your own lives. Are you really living by faith? Test yourselves. Do you not know that Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is in you?

am.L: በእምነት መሆናችሁን ራሳችሁን መርምሩ፤ ራሳችሁን ፈትኑ። ወይስ ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} በእናንተ [እንዳለ] ስለ ራሳችሁ አታውቁምን?
am.B: በእምነት ጸንታችሁ እንደ ሆነ ራሳችሁን በጥንቃቄ ተመልከቱ። ራሳችሁን ፈትኑ። ወይስ ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} በእናንተ ውስጥ እንዳለ በገዛ ሕይወታችሁ አታዩምን?

decisions.choice: yourselves: the stress falls on the Corinthians themselves
decisions.reason: Ἑαυτοὺς ("yourselves") comes first in both commands and again in the question. The Corinthians wanted proof about Paul (verse 3); Paul tells them to examine themselves instead.

decisions.choice: probe and test: two words for close examination, the second with the aim of proving what is genuine
decisions.reason: πειράζω is to try or probe something to see what it is; δοκιμάζω is to test, as metal is tested, to show whether it is genuine (8:8, 22). The second belongs to the family of "proof" in verse 3 and "fail the test" in verses 5-7.

decisions.choice: in the faith: living in trust in Christ, as true believers
decisions.reason: With the article, πίστει can mean the body of Christian belief, but here the question is whether they truly belong to Christ, as the next words show. The faith is the trust that joins them to him and the life that comes from it.

decisions.choice: a question expecting the answer "yes": surely you know that Jesus Christ is in you
decisions.reason: ἢ οὐκ ("or not") introduces a question that expects agreement. If Christ is in them, they are the proof that Christ speaks through Paul, since the church came to faith through his preaching (3:2-3).

decisions.choice: in you: in each of you, and among you as a church
decisions.reason: ὑμῖν is plural. Paul elsewhere speaks of Christ living in the believer (Galatians 2:20; Romans 8:10) and of the church as God's temple (1 Corinthians 3:16). Both are true here, and the words leave room for both.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: probe ... test (L); look closely at ... put to the test (B); look hard at ... test (R)
decisions.reason: Two different words; we keep them apart in English, and keep "test" for δοκιμάζω at every level so that the family of words in verses 3-7 stays visible (m2).

decisions.choice: really living by faith
decisions.reason: Readable says what being "in the faith" means (m3) and keeps the key term.

decisions.choice: examinez-vous ... mettez-vous à l’épreuve; échouer à l’épreuve, réussir l’épreuve (verses 5-7)
decisions.reason: The two verbs are kept apart (m2), and "l’épreuve" is used for the testing verb and for the adjectives "failing the test" and "passing the test" in verses 5-7, so the play on words stays as visible as in the English. "Réprouvés" would suggest condemnation by God, and "éprouvé" today mostly means "afflicted".

decisions.choice: poner a prueba; prueba (13:3); aprobado (10:18); reprobado (L), no pasar la prueba (B, R)
decisions.reason: Paul keeps one word family in view through 13:3-7: proof, test, approved, failing the test (meaning decisions). Spanish keeps it with "prueba / poner a prueba / aprobado"; Literal says "reprobado" for the negative, and Balanced and Readable say "no pasar la prueba", as the English says "fail the test".

decisions.choice: jichunguzeni ... jipimeni
decisions.reason: Two words for close examination (meaning decision): "kuchunguza" (to probe) and "kupima" (to test, as metal is tested to prove it genuine). "Kujaribu" is kept for testing that tempts.

decisions.choice: "tự xét ... tự thử" (L); "xem xét kỹ ... đặt mình vào sự thử nghiệm" (B); "nhìn kỹ ... tự thử nghiệm" (R) for peirazo and dokimazo
decisions.reason: Two words for close examination, the second with the aim of proving what is genuine (m2); "thử" carries the dokimos family through 13:5-7.

decisions.choice: "... sao?", a question expecting "yes"
decisions.reason: Surely you know that Jesus Christ is in you (m4); Vietnamese "không ... sao?" expects agreement.

decisions.choice: "살펴보다 ... 시험해 보다" (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the two verbs as close examination, the second aiming to prove what is genuine.

decisions.choice: Literal puts "여러분 자신" in each clause
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes that the stress falls on the Corinthians themselves.

decisions.choice: sondem ... provem (L); olhem atentamente ... ponham-se à prova (B); examinem bem ... ponham-se à prova (R)
decisions.reason: The two verbs are kept apart, and the second is "provar" / "pôr à prova" at every level, so that it stays in the family of "prova" (verse 3) and "reprovados" (verses 5-7) (m2).

records.literal_gloss: If not perhaps unapproved you are.

en.L: Unless indeed you are failing the test.
en.B: That is, unless you fail the test.
en.R: He is, unless you have failed the test.

fr.L: À moins qu’en fait vous n’échouiez à l’épreuve.
fr.B: C’est le cas, à moins que vous n’échouiez à l’épreuve.
fr.R: Il est en vous, sauf si vous avez échoué à l’épreuve.

es.B: Es decir, a menos que no {{plural_you:pasen|paséis}} la prueba.
es.R: Sí lo está, a menos que no {{plural_you:hayan|hayáis}} pasado la prueba.

vi.L: Trừ khi anh chị em bị loại.
vi.B: Nghĩa là, trừ khi anh chị em không đứng vững qua thử thách.
vi.R: Ngài ở trong anh chị em, trừ khi anh chị em đã không vượt qua được thử thách.

ko.B: 물론 여러분이 시험에서 떨어진 사람들이라면 그렇지 않겠지만 말입니다.
ko.R: 그분은 여러분 안에 계십니다. 여러분이 시험에 떨어진 것이 아니라면 말입니다.

pt.L: A não ser que, de fato, vocês estejam reprovados.
pt.B: Isto é, a não ser que vocês sejam reprovados na prova.
pt.R: Ele está, a não ser que vocês tenham sido reprovados na prova.

am.R: በእርግጥ በእናንተ ውስጥ አለ፤ ፈተናውን ካልወደቃችሁ በቀር።

decisions.choice: a short sentence that qualifies the question before it
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT ends the question and puts these words after it as a sentence of their own. They add a condition to "Jesus Christ is in you": unless the Corinthians fail the test Paul has just set.

decisions.choice: failing the test: shown by testing not to be genuine
decisions.reason: ἀδόκιμος is the opposite of δόκιμος, "tested and approved". It was used for coins or metal that failed the test. It belongs to the same family as "proof" (verse 3) and "test" (verse 5), and Paul uses it again in verses 6 and 7. In 1 Corinthians 9:27 he uses it of himself: he disciplines himself so as not to be disqualified.

decisions.choice: unless perhaps: Paul raises the possibility, but expects them to pass
decisions.reason: εἰ μήτι ("unless perhaps") states the condition without expecting it to be true. Verse 6 shows that he hopes for the best.

decisions.choice: fail the test
decisions.reason: "Fail the test" keeps the link with "test" in the sentence before and with verses 6-7, which the play on words depends on (m2).

decisions.choice: That is (B); He is (R)
decisions.reason: The words hang on the question before them. Balanced and Readable add a few words so that the sentence can stand on its own.

decisions.choice: mmeshindwa kuthibitika (L); mmeshindwa jaribio (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word is "not approved", the opposite of the approved of 10:18. Literal keeps the root "-thibitika" (to be proven) so the family can be traced through verses 5-7; Balanced and Readable say "kushindwa jaribio" (to fail the test), as the English does. "Kukataliwa" (rejected) would sound like God's final rejection.

decisions.choice: "bị loại" (L); "không đứng vững qua thử thách" (B); "không vượt qua được thử thách" (R) for adokimos (13:5-7)
decisions.reason: Shown by testing not to be genuine (m2); "bị loại" is the Literal word of 1 Corinthians 9:27, and Balanced takes the negative of its "đứng vững qua thử thách" for dokimos in 1 Corinthians 11:19, so the family stays visible.

decisions.choice: "Ngài ở trong anh chị em"
decisions.reason: As the English supplies "He is"; a sentence start, so the capital needs no span.

decisions.choice: "시험에 불합격하다" (L); "시험에서 떨어지다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as shown by testing not to be genuine; "버림받다" would add a sense of rejection by God the word does not have here.

decisions.choice: reprovados (L, B, R); aprovados for the opposite word (13:7)
decisions.reason: For the whole book. "Reprovado" and "aprovado" are the everyday Brazilian words for failing and passing a test, and they share the root of "prova", so the play on words in verses 3-7 survives in Portuguese as it does in the Greek (m2). "Desqualificado" sounds like sport, and "rejeitado" loses the test.

decisions.choice: ፈተናውን የወደቀ (failing the test); ፈተናውን ያለፈ (passing it), verses 5–7
decisions.reason: The Greek keeps one word family for testing, approved and failing the test; Amharic keeps it with ፈተና (test) each time, as 10:18 does for 'approved'.

source.text: ἐλπίζω δὲ ὅτι γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἡμεῖς οὐκ ἐσμὲν ἀδόκιμοι.

records.literal_gloss: I hope and that you will know that we not are unapproved.

en.L: But I hope that you will come to know that we are not failing the test.
en.B: And I hope you will see that we are not the ones who fail the test.
en.R: I hope you will see that we have passed the test.

fr.L: Mais j’espère que vous reconnaîtrez que nous, nous n’échouons pas à l’épreuve.
fr.B: Et j’espère que vous verrez que ce n’est pas nous qui échouons à l’épreuve.
fr.R: J’espère que vous verrez que nous avons réussi l’épreuve.

es.L: Pero espero que {{plural_you:lleguen|lleguéis}} a reconocer que nosotros no estamos reprobados.
es.B: Y espero que {{plural_you:reconozcan|reconozcáis}} que no somos nosotros los que no pasamos la prueba.
es.R: Espero que {{plural_you:vean|veáis}} que nosotros sí hemos pasado la prueba.

sw.L: Lakini natumaini kwamba mtatambua kwamba sisi hatujashindwa kuthibitika.
sw.B: Nami natumaini mtaona kwamba sisi si wale walioshindwa jaribio.
sw.R: Natumaini mtaona kwamba sisi tumefaulu jaribio.

vi.L: Nhưng tôi hy vọng anh chị em sẽ nhận biết rằng chúng tôi không bị loại.
vi.B: Và tôi hy vọng anh chị em sẽ thấy chúng tôi không phải là những người không đứng vững qua thử thách.
vi.R: Tôi hy vọng anh chị em sẽ thấy rằng chúng tôi đã vượt qua được thử thách.

ko.L: 그러나 나는 우리가 시험에 불합격한 사람들이 아니라는 것을 여러분이 알게 되기를 바랍니다.
ko.B: 그리고 나는 우리가 시험에서 떨어진 사람들이 아니라는 것을 여러분이 알게 되기를 바랍니다.
ko.R: 나는 우리가 시험에 합격했다는 것을 여러분이 알게 되기를 바랍니다.

pt.L: Mas espero que vocês venham a saber que nós não estamos reprovados.
pt.B: E espero que vocês vejam que não somos nós os reprovados.
pt.R: Espero que vocês vejam que nós passamos na prova.

am.L: ነገር ግን እኛ ፈተናውን የወደቅን እንዳልሆንን እንደምታውቁ ተስፋ አደርጋለሁ።
am.B: ፈተናውን የምንወድቀው እኛ እንዳልሆንን እንደምትገነዘቡ ተስፋ አደርጋለሁ።
am.R: እኛ ፈተናውን እንዳለፍን እንደምታዩ ተስፋ አደርጋለሁ።

decisions.choice: we, in contrast with you
decisions.reason: ἡμεῖς ("we") is stated for emphasis. The Corinthians were testing Paul; he hopes they will pass their own test and come to see that he has passed his.

decisions.choice: you will come to know: either through their own testing, or when Paul comes and acts with Christ's power
decisions.reason: If Christ is in them (verse 5), they themselves show that Paul's preaching was genuine. But verse 3 says his coming will give proof too. The future "you will know" may include both, and Paul does not say which he has in mind.

decisions.choice: we are not the ones who fail the test
alternatives: we have not failed the test
decisions.reason: Balanced brings out the emphatic "we" (m1).

decisions.choice: we have passed the test
alternatives: we are not failing the test
decisions.reason: Readable states positively what "not failing" means; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: "sẽ nhận biết" (L); "sẽ thấy" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Either through their own testing or when Paul comes (m2, uncertain); the verb leaves both open.

decisions.choice: "알게 되다" (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision leaves open whether they will know it by their own testing or when Paul comes.

source.text: εὐχόμεθα δὲ πρὸς τὸν θεὸν μὴ ποιῆσαι ὑμᾶς κακὸν μηδέν, οὐχ ἵνα ἡμεῖς δόκιμοι φανῶμεν, ἀλλ’ ἵνα ὑμεῖς τὸ καλὸν ποιῆτε, ἡμεῖς δὲ ὡς ἀδόκιμοι ὦμεν.

records.literal_gloss: We pray and to the God not to do you wrong nothing, not that we approved may appear, but that you the good may do, we and as unapproved may be.

en.L: But we pray to God that you do nothing wrong, not so that we may appear [as] passing the test, but so that you may do what is good, even if we may be as [those] failing the test.
en.B: Our prayer to God is that you will do no wrong at all. Our aim is not to look as though we have passed the test; we want you to do what is good, even if we then look like people who have failed it.
en.R: We ask God to keep you from doing anything wrong. We are not asking this so that we will look good, as people who passed the test. We want you to do what is good, even if it seems that we have failed the test.

fr.L: Or nous prions Dieu que vous ne fassiez aucun mal, non pour que nous, nous paraissions avoir réussi l’épreuve, mais pour que vous, vous fassiez le bien, même si nous, nous sommes comme [ceux qui] échouent à l’épreuve.
fr.B: Nous prions Dieu que vous ne fassiez aucun mal. Notre but n’est pas de paraître avoir réussi l’épreuve ; nous voulons que vous fassiez le bien, même si nous paraissons alors avoir échoué.
fr.R: Nous demandons à Dieu de vous empêcher de faire quoi que ce soit de mal. Nous ne le demandons pas pour avoir l’air bons, comme des gens qui ont réussi l’épreuve. Nous voulons que vous fassiez ce qui est bien, même s’il semble que nous avons échoué à l’épreuve.

es.L: Pero oramos a Dios que no {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} nada malo, no para que nosotros aparezcamos aprobados, sino para que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} lo bueno, aunque nosotros seamos como reprobados.
es.B: Nuestra oración a Dios es que no {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} nada malo. Lo que buscamos no es parecer aprobados; queremos que {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} lo bueno, aunque entonces nosotros parezcamos gente que no ha pasado la prueba.
es.R: Le pedimos a Dios que {{plural_you:los|os}} guarde de hacer algo malo. No lo pedimos para quedar bien, como personas que pasaron la prueba. Queremos que {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} lo bueno, aunque parezca que nosotros no hemos pasado la prueba.

sw.L: Lakini tunamwomba Mungu kwamba msitende ubaya wowote, si ili sisi tuonekane tumethibitika, bali ili ninyi mtende lililo jema, hata kama sisi tuwe kama wasiothibitika.
sw.B: Maombi yetu kwa Mungu ni kwamba msitende ubaya wowote kabisa. Lengo letu si kuonekana kuwa tumefaulu jaribio; tunataka ninyi mtende yaliyo mema, hata kama sisi tutaonekana kama watu walioshindwa jaribio.
sw.R: Tunamwomba Mungu awazuie msitende jambo lolote baya. Hatuombi hivyo ili tuonekane wazuri, kama watu waliofaulu jaribio. Tunataka ninyi mtende yaliyo mema, hata kama itaonekana kwamba sisi tumeshindwa jaribio.

vi.L: Nhưng chúng tôi cầu xin Đức Chúa Trời để anh chị em không làm điều ác nào, không phải để chúng tôi tỏ ra là được chấp nhận, nhưng để anh chị em làm điều tốt, dù chúng tôi có như [những người] bị loại.
vi.B: Chúng tôi cầu xin Đức Chúa Trời cho anh chị em không làm điều sai trái nào cả. Mục đích của chúng tôi không phải là để mình có vẻ như đã đứng vững qua thử thách; chúng tôi muốn anh chị em làm điều tốt, dù khi đó chúng tôi trông như những người không đứng vững qua thử thách.
vi.R: Chúng tôi cầu xin Đức Chúa Trời giữ anh chị em khỏi làm bất cứ điều gì sai trái. Chúng tôi không cầu xin điều này để mình trông tốt đẹp, như những người đã vượt qua thử thách. Chúng tôi muốn anh chị em làm điều tốt, dù có vẻ như chúng tôi đã không vượt qua được thử thách.

ko.L: 우리는 여러분이 아무 악도 행하지 않기를 하나님께 기도합니다. 우리가 시험에 합격한 사람으로 보이려는 것이 아니라, 우리는 시험에 불합격한 사람처럼 되더라도 여러분은 선을 행하게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 우리가 하나님께 드리는 기도는 여러분이 어떤 잘못도 저지르지 않는 것입니다. 우리가 시험에 합격한 사람처럼 보이려는 것이 아닙니다. 그렇게 되어 우리가 시험에서 떨어진 사람처럼 보이더라도, 우리는 여러분이 선한 일을 하기를 원합니다.
ko.R: 우리는 하나님께 여러분이 잘못된 일을 하지 않게 지켜 달라고 기도합니다. 우리가 시험에 합격한 사람으로서 좋게 보이려고 이렇게 기도하는 것이 아닙니다. 우리는 여러분이 선한 일을 하기를 원합니다. 비록 우리가 시험에 떨어진 것처럼 보이더라도 말입니다.

pt.L: Mas oramos a Deus para que vocês não façam mal algum, não para que nós pareçamos aprovados, mas para que vocês façam o bem, ainda que nós sejamos como reprovados.
pt.B: A nossa oração a Deus é que vocês não façam mal nenhum. O nosso objetivo não é parecer que fomos aprovados; queremos que vocês façam o que é bom, ainda que nós então pareçamos reprovados.
pt.R: Pedimos a Deus que guarde vocês de fazer qualquer coisa errada. Não pedimos isso para parecermos bons, como pessoas que passaram na prova. Queremos que vocês façam o que é bom, mesmo que pareça que nós fomos reprovados.

am.L: ነገር ግን ምንም ክፉ እንዳታደርጉ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንጸልያለን፤ ይህም እኛ ፈተናውን ያለፍን ሆነን እንድንታይ አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን እኛ ፈተናውን እንደ ወደቁ ብንሆን እንኳ እናንተ መልካሙን እንድታደርጉ ነው።
am.B: ወደ እግዚአብሔር የምንጸልየው ምንም ክፉ እንዳታደርጉ ነው። ዓላማችን ፈተናውን ያለፍን መስለን መታየት አይደለም፤ ይልቁንም ፈተናውን እንደ ወደቁ ሰዎች ብንታይ እንኳ እናንተ መልካሙን እንድታደርጉ እንፈልጋለን።
am.R: ምንም ክፉ ነገር ከማድረግ እንዲጠብቃችሁ እግዚአብሔርን እንለምናለን። ይህን የምንለምነው ፈተናውን እንዳለፉ ሰዎች መልካም ሆነን እንድንታይ አይደለም። ፈተናውን የወደቅን ቢመስልም እንኳ እናንተ መልካም የሆነውን እንድታደርጉ እንፈልጋለን።

decisions.choice: that you do no wrong
alternatives: that we (or God) do you no harm
decisions.reason: ὑμᾶς ("you") is the subject of ποιῆσαι ("to do"): Paul prays that the Corinthians will do nothing wrong. Grammatically it could be the object, but the next clause, "that you may do what is good", shows the sense.

decisions.choice: passing the test, failing the test
decisions.reason: δόκιμος is what has been tested and approved; ἀδόκιμος is its opposite, as in verses 5-6.

decisions.choice: Paul would rather seem weak than have them do wrong: if they put things right, he will have no need to show his power, and so may seem to have failed
decisions.reason: Paul's power is for building up (verse 10). If the Corinthians do what is right, he will not need to discipline anyone, and those who want a show of strength will think he has failed the test. He accepts that. His aim is their good, not his own standing (12:19).

decisions.choice: Our aim is ...; we want you to
decisions.reason: Balanced breaks the long clause and says plainly whose aim is in view.

decisions.choice: so that we will look good, as people who passed the test
alternatives: so that we may appear approved
decisions.reason: Readable says what appearing to pass the test would mean for Paul, and keeps the word "test".

decisions.choice: "được chấp nhận ... bị loại" (L); "đứng vững qua thử thách ... không đứng vững qua thử thách" (B); "vượt qua thử thách ... không vượt qua được thử thách" (R)
decisions.reason: Passing the test, failing the test (m2); each level keeps one pair, as in 10:18 and 13:5-6.

decisions.choice: "시험에 합격하다" and "시험에 불합격하다" (L); "합격하다", "떨어지다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the pair as passing and failing the test; the same words run from verse 5.

source.text: οὐ γὰρ δυνάμεθά τι κατὰ τῆς ἀληθείας, ἀλλὰ ὑπὲρ τῆς ἀληθείας.

records.literal_gloss: Not for we are able anything against the truth, but for the truth.

en.L: For we are not able [to do] anything against the truth, but [only] on behalf of the truth.
en.B: We have no power to act against the truth, only to act for it.
en.R: We can do nothing that goes against the truth. We can only do what helps the truth.

fr.L: Car nous ne pouvons rien contre la vérité, mais [seulement] pour la vérité.
fr.B: Nous n’avons aucun pouvoir contre la vérité, seulement pour elle.
fr.R: Nous ne pouvons rien faire qui aille contre la vérité. Nous pouvons seulement faire ce qui sert la vérité.

es.L: Porque no podemos [hacer] nada contra la verdad, sino [solo] a favor de la verdad.
es.B: No tenemos poder para actuar contra la verdad, sino solo a favor de ella.
es.R: No podemos hacer nada que vaya contra la verdad. Solo podemos hacer lo que ayuda a la verdad.

sw.L: Kwa maana hatuwezi [kufanya] kitu dhidi ya kweli, bali [tu] kwa ajili ya kweli.
sw.B: Hatuna uwezo wa kutenda dhidi ya kweli, ila tu kwa ajili yake.
sw.R: Hatuwezi kufanya lolote linalopingana na kweli. Tunaweza tu kufanya yale yanayosaidia kweli.

vi.L: Vì chúng tôi không thể [làm] điều gì chống lại chân lý, nhưng [chỉ] vì chân lý.
vi.B: Chúng tôi không có quyền năng để làm điều gì chống lại chân lý, mà chỉ để làm điều cho chân lý.
vi.R: Chúng tôi không thể làm điều gì đi ngược lại chân lý. Chúng tôi chỉ có thể làm những gì giúp ích cho chân lý.

ko.L: 우리는 진리를 거슬러서는 아무것도 [할] 수 없고, 진리를 위해서만 [할 수 있습니다].
ko.B: 우리는 진리를 거슬러 행동할 힘이 없고, 오직 진리를 위해서만 행동할 수 있습니다.
ko.R: 우리는 진리를 거스르는 일은 아무것도 할 수 없습니다. 우리는 진리를 돕는 일만 할 수 있습니다.

pt.L: Pois não podemos [fazer] nada contra a verdade, mas [somente] em favor da verdade.
pt.B: Não temos poder para agir contra a verdade, mas só a favor dela.
pt.R: Não podemos fazer nada contra a verdade. Só podemos fazer o que ajuda a verdade.

am.L: በእውነት ላይ ምንም [ልናደርግ] አንችልምና፤ ለእውነት [ብቻ] እንጂ።
am.B: በእውነት ላይ ለመሥራት ኃይል የለንም፤ ያለን ለእውነት ለመሥራት ብቻ ነው።
am.R: እውነትን የሚቃወም ምንም ነገር ማድረግ አንችልም። ልናደርግ የምንችለው እውነትን የሚረዳውን ብቻ ነው።

decisions.choice: the truth: the truth of the gospel and what is right in God's sight
decisions.reason: ἀληθείας here is the truth of God made known in the gospel (4:2; 6:7) and the right way of life that goes with it. If the Corinthians do what is right, Paul's authority has nothing to act against.

decisions.choice: we are able: Paul's apostolic power can only be used for the truth, never against it
decisions.reason: δυνάμεθά ("we are able") picks up the theme of power in verses 3-4. Paul's authority is not a personal power that he can use as he likes; it serves the truth.

decisions.choice: [to do] ... [only] (L); to act ... only (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb after "we are able" and no word for "only"; English needs both.

decisions.choice: nous ne pouvons rien contre, with no supplied verb
decisions.reason: French "ne rien pouvoir contre" is idiomatic without a second verb, so Literal brackets only "[seulement]", where the English also supplies "[to do]".

decisions.choice: "chân lý" for aletheia
decisions.reason: The truth of the gospel and what is right in God's sight (m1); as in 4:2, 6:7 and 11:10.

decisions.choice: "[할]", "[할 수 있습니다]" (L)
decisions.reason: The English Literal supplies "[to do]" and "[only]"; Korean needs the verb, and "만" carries "only".

source.text: χαίρομεν γὰρ ὅταν ἡμεῖς ἀσθενῶμεν, ὑμεῖς δὲ δυνατοὶ ἦτε· τοῦτο καὶ εὐχόμεθα, τὴν ὑμῶν κατάρτισιν.

records.literal_gloss: We rejoice for when we are weak, you and strong are; this also we pray, the of you restoration.

en.L: For we rejoice whenever we may be weak and you may be strong; this also we pray for: your restoration.
en.B: We are glad to be weak if it means that you are strong. Indeed, we pray for this: that you will be mended and made whole.
en.R: We are happy to be weak when you are strong. And we pray that you will be made whole again.

fr.L: Car nous nous réjouissons quand nous, nous sommes faibles et que vous, vous êtes forts ; cela aussi, nous le demandons dans la prière : votre restauration.
fr.B: Nous sommes heureux d’être faibles si cela veut dire que vous êtes forts. Et voici ce que nous demandons dans nos prières : que vous soyez rétablis et rendus entiers.
fr.R: Nous sommes contents d’être faibles quand vous êtes forts. Et nous prions pour que vous soyez complètement rétablis.

es.L: Porque nos alegramos cuando nosotros somos débiles y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:son|sois}} fuertes; y esto también pedimos en oración: {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} restauración.
es.B: Nos alegramos de ser débiles si eso significa que {{plural_you:ustedes son|vosotros sois}} fuertes. Y por esto oramos: que {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} restaurados y {{plural_you:queden|quedéis}} completos.
es.R: Estamos felices de ser débiles cuando {{plural_you:ustedes son|vosotros sois}} fuertes. Y oramos para que {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} restaurados por completo.

sw.L: Kwa maana tunafurahi kila tunapokuwa dhaifu na ninyi mkiwa na nguvu; hili pia tunaliomba: kurejeshwa kwenu katika hali kamili.
sw.B: Tunafurahi kuwa dhaifu ikiwa ni kwa sababu ninyi mna nguvu. Naam, tunaomba hili: kwamba mrekebishwe na kufanywa kamili.
sw.R: Tunafurahi kuwa dhaifu wakati ninyi mna nguvu. Na tunaomba kwamba mfanywe kamili tena.

vi.L: Vì chúng tôi vui mừng khi chúng tôi yếu đuối còn anh chị em mạnh mẽ; điều này chúng tôi cũng cầu xin: sự hàn gắn của anh chị em.
vi.B: Chúng tôi vui mừng được yếu đuối, nếu điều đó có nghĩa là anh chị em mạnh mẽ. Thật vậy, chúng tôi cầu xin điều này: anh chị em được hàn gắn và trở nên trọn vẹn.
vi.R: Chúng tôi vui khi mình yếu đuối mà anh chị em mạnh mẽ. Và chúng tôi cầu xin cho anh chị em được trọn vẹn trở lại.

ko.L: 우리는 약하고 여러분은 강할 때 기뻐합니다. 우리는 이것, 곧 여러분이 온전하게 되는 것을 위해서도 기도합니다.
ko.B: 여러분이 강해진다면 우리는 약해도 기쁩니다. 사실 우리는 이것을 위해 기도합니다. 여러분이 바로잡혀서 온전하게 되는 것입니다.
ko.R: 여러분이 강하다면 우리는 약해도 기쁩니다. 그리고 우리는 여러분이 다시 온전하게 되기를 기도합니다.

pt.L: Pois nos alegramos sempre que nós estivermos fracos e vocês estiverem fortes; isto também pedimos em oração: a restauração de vocês.
pt.B: Ficamos contentes de ser fracos se isso significa que vocês são fortes. E é por isso mesmo que oramos: que vocês sejam restaurados e fiquem inteiros.
pt.R: Ficamos felizes em ser fracos quando vocês estão fortes. E oramos para que vocês fiquem inteiros de novo.

am.L: እኛ ደካሞች ስንሆን እናንተ ግን ብርቱዎች ስትሆኑ ደስ ይለናልና፤ ይህንም ደግሞ እንጸልያለን፤ [ይኸውም] መታደሳችሁ [ነው]።
am.B: እናንተ ብርቱዎች የምትሆኑ ከሆነ እኛ ደካሞች በመሆናችን ደስ ይለናል። ደግሞም ስለዚህ እንጸልያለን፤ ይኸውም ተጠግናችሁ ሙሉ እንድትሆኑ ነው።
am.R: እናንተ ብርቱዎች ስትሆኑ እኛ ደካሞች በመሆናችን ደስ ይለናል። እንደ ገና ሙሉ እንድትሆኑም እንጸልያለን።

decisions.choice: Paul is glad to seem weak if the Corinthians are strong
decisions.reason: If the Corinthians are strong in faith and do what is right, Paul will not need to use his authority against them, and he will look weak (verse 7). He welcomes that.

decisions.choice: restoration: being put back into good order and made complete
decisions.reason: κατάρτισις occurs only here in the New Testament. Its verb καταρτίζω (verse 11) is used for mending nets (Mark 1:19), for restoring a person who has fallen (Galatians 6:1) and for making something complete and ready (1 Corinthians 1:10). After the quarrels and sins of 12:20-21, Paul prays that the church will be set right and made whole.

decisions.choice: mended and made whole (B); made whole again (R)
decisions.reason: "Perfection" suggests flawlessness; "restoration" is abstract. Balanced uses the picture of mending, as at 1 Corinthians 1:10, and adds "made whole" for the sense of completeness (m2). Literal keeps "restoration".

decisions.choice: if it means that
decisions.reason: Balanced spells out the link between Paul's weakness and their strength (m1).

decisions.choice: votre restauration (L); rétablis et rendus entiers (B); complètement rétablis (R); the same verb in 13:11
decisions.reason: "Perfectionnement" suggests flawlessness. The sense is being put back into good order and made complete (m2); "rétablir" says that in ordinary French, and Balanced adds "rendus entiers" for completeness, as the English adds "made whole".

decisions.choice: kurejeshwa katika hali kamili (L); kurekebishwa na kufanywa kamili (B); kufanywa kamili tena (R)
decisions.reason: The word is being put back into good order (meaning decision), like mending a net or setting a bone, so Swahili says "kurejeshwa" / "kurekebishwa" (restored, mended) rather than "ukamilifu" (perfection). The verb of verse 11 is rendered the same way.

decisions.choice: "sự hàn gắn" (L); "được hàn gắn và trở nên trọn vẹn" (B); "được trọn vẹn trở lại" (R) for katartisis, and the verb in 13:11
decisions.reason: Being put back into good order and made complete (m2); "hàn gắn" is the Literal word of 1 Corinthians 1:10 for the same family, mending what was torn.

decisions.choice: "온전하게 되다" (L, R); "바로잡혀서 온전하게 되다" (B)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as being put back into good order and made complete; the verb of verse 11 is rendered with the same Korean.

decisions.choice: restaurados e fiquem inteiros (B); fiquem inteiros de novo (R)
decisions.reason: Portuguese "consertar", the everyday word for mending, sounds mechanical when said of people. "Restaurar" keeps the sense of putting something back in good order, and "ficar inteiro" the sense of being made whole (m2); "aperfeiçoar" would suggest flawlessness, as the English decision says of "perfection".

source.text: διὰ τοῦτο ταῦτα ἀπὼν γράφω, ἵνα παρὼν μὴ ἀποτόμως χρήσωμαι κατὰ τὴν ἐξουσίαν ἣν ὁ κύριος ἔδωκέν μοι, εἰς οἰκοδομὴν καὶ οὐκ εἰς καθαίρεσιν.

records.literal_gloss: Because of this these things being absent I write, so that being present not severely I may deal according to the authority which the Lord gave me, for building up and not for tearing down.

en.L: For this reason I write these things while absent, so that when present I may not act severely according to the authority that the Lord gave me, for building up and not for tearing down.
en.B: That is why I am writing this while I am still away: so that when I come I need not deal with you sharply, using the authority the Lord gave me, which is for building up and not for tearing down.
en.R: That is why I am writing this letter before I come. When I am with you, I do not want to be hard on you. The Lord gave me authority to build you up, not to knock you down.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi j’écris ces choses en étant absent, afin qu’étant présent je n’agisse pas avec sévérité selon l’autorité que le Seigneur m’a donnée pour l’édification et non pour la démolition.
fr.B: Voilà pourquoi je vous écris cela pendant que je suis encore loin : pour ne pas avoir, une fois là, à vous traiter durement en usant de l’autorité que le Seigneur m’a donnée, une autorité qui est faite pour édifier et non pour démolir.
fr.R: C’est pour cela que je vous écris cette lettre avant de venir. Quand je serai avec vous, je ne veux pas être dur avec vous. Le Seigneur m’a donné de l’autorité pour vous faire grandir, pas pour vous démolir.

es.L: Por esto escribo estas cosas estando ausente, para que, estando presente, no tenga que actuar con severidad conforme a la autoridad que el Señor me dio para edificación y no para destrucción.
es.B: Por eso escribo esto mientras todavía estoy lejos: para que, cuando llegue, no tenga que {{plural_you:tratarlos|trataros}} con dureza, usando la autoridad que el Señor me dio, que es para edificar y no para destruir.
es.R: Por eso {{plural_you:les|os}} escribo esta carta antes de ir. Cuando esté con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, no quiero ser duro con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. El Señor me dio autoridad para {{plural_you:fortalecerlos|fortaleceros}}, no para {{plural_you:derribarlos|derribaros}}.

sw.L: Kwa sababu hii ninaandika mambo haya nikiwa mbali, ili nikiwapo nisitende kwa ukali kwa kadiri ya mamlaka ambayo Bwana alinipa, kwa kujenga wala si kwa kubomoa.
sw.B: Ndiyo sababu ninaandika haya ningali mbali: ili nitakapokuja nisilazimike kuwashughulikia kwa ukali, nikitumia mamlaka ambayo Bwana alinipa, ambayo ni ya kujenga wala si ya kubomoa.
sw.R: Ndiyo sababu ninaandika barua hii kabla sijaja. Nitakapokuwa pamoja nanyi, sitaki kuwa mkali kwenu. Bwana alinipa mamlaka ili niwajenge, si ili niwaangushe.

vi.L: Vì lý do này, tôi viết những điều này khi vắng mặt, để khi có mặt, tôi không phải hành động nghiêm khắc theo quyền mà Chúa đã ban cho tôi, để gây dựng chứ không phải để phá đổ.
vi.B: Đó là lý do tôi viết những điều này trong khi còn vắng mặt: để khi tôi đến, tôi không cần phải đối xử nghiêm khắc với anh chị em, dùng quyền Chúa đã ban cho tôi, là quyền để gây dựng chứ không phải để phá đổ.
vi.R: Vì vậy tôi viết lá thư này trước khi tôi đến. Khi ở với anh chị em, tôi không muốn phải cứng rắn với anh chị em. Chúa đã ban cho tôi quyền để gây dựng anh chị em, chứ không phải để đánh đổ anh chị em.

ko.L: 그러므로 내가 떠나 있는 동안 이것들을 쓰는 것은, 내가 가서 있을 때, 주님께서 무너뜨리라고가 아니라 세우라고 나에게 주신 권위를 따라 엄하게 대하지 않으려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 그래서 나는 아직 떠나 있는 동안 이 편지를 씁니다. 내가 갈 때 주님께서 나에게 주신 권위를 사용해서 여러분을 엄하게 대하지 않아도 되게 하려는 것입니다. 그 권위는 세우라고 주신 것이지 무너뜨리라고 주신 것이 아닙니다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 여러분에게 가기 전에 이 편지를 씁니다. 나는 여러분과 함께 있을 때 여러분을 엄하게 대하고 싶지 않습니다. 주님께서 나에게 권위를 주신 것은 여러분을 세우라고 주신 것이지, 쓰러뜨리라고 주신 것이 아닙니다.

pt.L: Por isso escrevo estas coisas estando ausente, para que, estando presente, eu não aja com severidade, segundo a autoridade que o Senhor me deu para edificação e não para destruição.
pt.B: É por isso que escrevo estas coisas enquanto ainda estou longe: para que, quando eu chegar, não precise tratar vocês com dureza, usando a autoridade que o Senhor me deu, que é para edificar e não para destruir.
pt.R: É por isso que estou escrevendo esta carta antes de ir até vocês. Quando eu estiver com vocês, não quero ser duro com vocês. O Senhor me deu autoridade para fortalecer vocês, não para derrubar vocês.

am.L: ስለዚህ ርቄ ሳለሁ ይህን እጽፋለሁ፤ ይኸውም በምገኝበት ጊዜ ጌታ ለማፍረስ ሳይሆን ለማነጽ በሰጠኝ ሥልጣን መሠረት በጭካኔ እንዳላደርግ ነው።
am.B: ገና ርቄ ሳለሁ ይህን የምጽፈው ስለዚህ ነው፤ ስመጣ ጌታ በሰጠኝ ሥልጣን ተጠቅሜ በእናንተ ላይ በኃይለ ቃል እንዳልሠራ ነው፤ ይህ ሥልጣን ለማነጽ እንጂ ለማፍረስ አይደለም።
am.R: ከመምጣቴ በፊት ይህን መልእክት የምጽፈው ስለዚህ ነው። ከእናንተ ጋር ስሆን በእናንተ ላይ መጨከን አልፈልግም። ጌታ ሥልጣን የሰጠኝ እናንተን ለመገንባት እንጂ ለማፍረስ አይደለም።

decisions.choice: deal severely: act sharply, cutting off the offender
decisions.reason: ἀποτόμως comes from a word for cutting off; it describes stern, unsparing action (Titus 1:13). Paul writes now so that he will not need to act this way when he comes.

decisions.choice: building up and not tearing down: the same words as 10:8, echoing the call of Jeremiah
decisions.reason: Paul used the same pair in 10:8 about the authority the Lord gave him. The language recalls Jeremiah, who was appointed to build and to plant, to tear down and to overthrow (Jeremiah 1:10; 24:6). Paul's authority can discipline, but its purpose is to build the church up.

decisions.choice: the Lord: the Lord Jesus, who sent Paul
decisions.reason: Paul's authority as an apostle comes from the risen Lord Jesus who appeared to him and sent him (1 Corinthians 9:1; Galatians 1:1).

decisions.choice: this letter
decisions.reason: Readable says that "these things" are the letter he is writing.

decisions.choice: build you up, not tear you down (R)
alternatives: for building up and not for tearing down
decisions.reason: Readable makes the Corinthians the ones built up, as the whole sentence implies.

decisions.choice: l’édification ... la démolition (L); édifier ... démolir (B); vous faire grandir ... vous démolir (R), as in 12:19
decisions.reason: "Édifier" keeps the building picture and is the usual French word for helping a church grow; "démolir" is its opposite in the same picture. Readable says "faire grandir", the plain sense, as in 12:19.

decisions.choice: kujenga ... kubomoa (L, B); niwajenge ... niwaangushe (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as 10:8, which this verse repeats (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "gây dựng ... phá đổ" (L, B); "gây dựng ... đánh đổ" (R), as in 10:8
decisions.reason: The same words as 10:8 (m2), so the Vietnamese repeats them.

decisions.choice: "hành động nghiêm khắc" (L); "đối xử nghiêm khắc" (B); "cứng rắn" (R) for apotomos
decisions.reason: Acting sharply, cutting off the offender (m1).

decisions.choice: "권위", "세우다", "무너뜨리다" (L, B); "쓰러뜨리다" (R), the words of 10:8
decisions.reason: The same pair as 10:8, kept the same at each level.

decisions.choice: "엄하게 대하다" at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as stern, unsparing action.

decisions.choice: para fortalecer vocês, não para derrubar vocês
alternatives: para edificar vocês, não para destruir vocês
decisions.reason: As in 12:19, Readable says "fortalecer" for building people up; "derrubar" keeps the picture of tearing down a building, so the contrast stays visible (m2).

source.text: Λοιπόν, ἀδελφοί, χαίρετε, καταρτίζεσθε, παρακαλεῖσθε, τὸ αὐτὸ φρονεῖτε, εἰρηνεύετε, καὶ ὁ θεὸς τῆς ἀγάπης καὶ εἰρήνης ἔσται μεθ’ ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Finally, brothers, rejoice, be restored, be comforted, the same think, be at peace, and the God of the love and peace will be with you.

en.L: Finally, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, rejoice, be restored, be comforted, think the same [thing], be at peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
en.B: Finally, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, rejoice. Let yourselves be mended, be encouraged, be of one mind, and keep the peace among you. Then the God of love and peace will be with you.
en.R: Finally, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, be full of joy. Let yourselves be made whole again. Take courage. Agree with each other. Live in peace together. Then God, who loves you and gives peace, will be with you.

fr.L: Au reste, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, réjouissez-vous, soyez restaurés, soyez réconfortés, pensez la même [chose], vivez en paix, et le Dieu de l’amour et de la paix sera avec vous.
fr.B: Enfin, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, réjouissez-vous. Laissez-vous rétablir, laissez-vous encourager, soyez d’un même avis, et gardez la paix entre vous. Alors le Dieu de l’amour et de la paix sera avec vous.
fr.R: Pour finir, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, soyez pleins de joie. Laissez-vous rétablir complètement. Prenez courage. Mettez-vous d’accord entre vous. Vivez en paix ensemble. Alors Dieu, qui vous aime et qui donne la paix, sera avec vous.

es.L: Por lo demás, hermanos, {{plural_you:alégrense|alegraos}}, {{plural_you:sean|sed}} restaurados, {{plural_you:sean|sed}} consolados, {{plural_you:piensen|pensad}} lo mismo, {{plural_you:vivan|vivid}} en paz, y el Dios del amor y de la paz estará con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Por último, hermanos, {{plural_you:alégrense|alegraos}}. {{plural_you:Déjense|Dejaos}} restaurar, {{plural_you:anímense|animaos}}, {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} un mismo sentir y {{plural_you:vivan|vivid}} en paz entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Entonces el Dios del amor y de la paz estará con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Por último, hermanos, {{plural_you:estén|estad}} llenos de alegría. {{plural_you:Déjense|Dejaos}} restaurar. {{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} ánimo. {{plural_you:Pónganse|Poneos}} de acuerdo unos con otros. {{plural_you:Vivan|Vivid}} en paz. Entonces Dios, que {{plural_you:los|os}} ama y {{plural_you:les|os}} da paz, estará con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

sw.L: Hatimaye, ndugu, furahini, mrejeshwe katika hali kamili, mfarijiwe, mwe na nia moja, kaeni kwa amani, na Mungu wa upendo na amani atakuwa pamoja nanyi.
sw.B: Hatimaye, ndugu, furahini. Kubalini kurekebishwa, mfarijiwe, mwe na nia moja, na mdumishe amani kati yenu. Ndipo Mungu wa upendo na amani atakuwa pamoja nanyi.
sw.R: Hatimaye, ndugu, jaeni furaha. Kubalini kufanywa kamili tena. Pokeeni faraja. Kubalianeni ninyi kwa ninyi. Ishini kwa amani pamoja. Ndipo Mungu, anayewapenda na kuwapa amani, atakuwa pamoja nanyi.

vi.L: Sau cùng, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, hãy vui mừng, hãy được hàn gắn, hãy được an ủi, hãy cùng một suy nghĩ, hãy sống hòa thuận, và Đức Chúa Trời của tình yêu thương và sự bình an sẽ ở cùng anh chị em.
vi.B: Sau cùng, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, hãy vui mừng. Hãy để mình được hàn gắn, hãy được khích lệ, hãy đồng một tâm trí, và hãy giữ hòa thuận với nhau. Rồi Đức Chúa Trời của tình yêu thương và sự bình an sẽ ở cùng anh chị em.
vi.R: Sau cùng, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, hãy luôn vui mừng. Hãy để mình được trọn vẹn trở lại. Hãy vững lòng. Hãy đồng ý với nhau. Hãy sống hòa thuận với nhau. Rồi Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng yêu thương anh chị em và ban sự bình an, sẽ ở cùng anh chị em.

ko.L: 마지막으로, {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 기뻐하십시오. 온전하게 되십시오. 위로를 받으십시오. 같은 생각을 품으십시오. 평화롭게 지내십시오. 그러면 사랑과 평화의 하나님께서 여러분과 함께 계실 것입니다.

decisions.choice: rejoice
decisions.reason: χαίρετε was the ordinary Greek word for "greetings" or "goodbye", and here it stands at the close of a letter. But it is followed by four more commands, and Paul often calls on believers to rejoice (Philippians 3:1; 4:4; 1 Thessalonians 5:16). We read "rejoice", perhaps with a note of farewell.

decisions.choice: be restored: let yourselves be put right and made whole
decisions.reason: καταρτίζεσθε is the verb of the noun in verse 9, "restoration": mending what is torn and putting it in good order. The form can be passive ("be restored") or middle ("put things right"). Either way the church is called to let its divisions and sins be set right.

decisions.choice: be comforted and encouraged
decisions.reason: παρακαλέω is the comfort of 1:3-7, which includes strengthening and encouragement; it can also mean to urge or appeal. As a passive it may mean "receive comfort" or "take my appeal to heart"; as a middle, "encourage one another". We read it as receiving the encouragement and strength that God gives, as in chapter 1.

decisions.choice: think the same thing: be united in mind and purpose
decisions.reason: The phrase is Paul's way of calling a church to agree and to work together (Romans 12:16; Philippians 2:2; 4:2). It does not mean that everyone must hold the same opinion on every matter.

decisions.choice: a promise: the God who gives love and peace will be with them
alternatives: a reward earned by obeying the commands
decisions.reason: "The God of love and peace" is the God who is loving and who gives peace (Romans 15:33; Philippians 4:9). The "and" joins the promise to the commands: as they live in peace, they will know God's presence. It is a promise of his presence, not a wage for good behavior.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: The church included women and men.

decisions.choice: be encouraged (B); take courage (R)
decisions.reason: In 1:3-7 the same word is "comfort" at every level. Here, as a command at the close of a letter, "be comforted" sounds as if the readers were grieving; Balanced and Readable bring out the strengthening sense (m3). Literal keeps "comforted".

decisions.choice: Then
decisions.reason: The promise follows from the commands (m5); "then" makes the link clear.

decisions.choice: God, who loves you and gives peace
alternatives: the God of love and peace
decisions.reason: Readable says what "the God of love and peace" means (m5) and keeps the key term.

decisions.choice: {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}
decisions.reason: As in English, the church is addressed as men and women together; "frères" stays available as the traditional form.

decisions.choice: soyez réconfortés (L)
decisions.reason: "Réconforter" covers both comfort and strengthening (m3), where "consoler" would suggest that the readers were grieving. Balanced and Readable bring out the strengthening sense, as the English does.

decisions.choice: consolados (L); anímense (B); tengan ánimo (R)
decisions.reason: Elsewhere in the letter the comfort word is "consolar" at every level, and Literal keeps it here. In this closing call the sense leans to encouragement and heeding Paul's appeal, so Balanced and Readable say "ánimo", as the English says "be encouraged" and "take courage".

decisions.choice: mfarijiwe (L, B); pokeeni faraja (R)
decisions.reason: As set in 1:3, the comfort word keeps "faraja" / "kufariji" at every level, where the English Balanced and Readable say "be encouraged", "take courage"; "ndugu" needs no gender span, as elsewhere in this letter.

decisions.choice: "hãy được an ủi" (L); "hãy được khích lệ" (B); "Hãy vững lòng" (R) for parakaleisthe
decisions.reason: Be comforted and encouraged (m3, uncertain); "an ủi" is the book's Literal word for the paraklesis family from 1:3-7.

decisions.choice: "Đức Chúa Trời của tình yêu thương và sự bình an" (L, B); "Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng yêu thương ... và ban sự bình an" (R)
alternatives: "Đức Chúa Trời của sự yêu thương"
decisions.reason: The God who gives love and peace (m5); "Đức Chúa Trời của sự bình an" is the form of the Vietnamese Philippians 4:9 and 1 Thessalonians 5:23, and "tình yêu thương" stays the word for agape.

decisions.choice: "기뻐하십시오" (L, B); "기쁨이 가득하십시오" (R)
decisions.reason: The word can also mean "farewell"; the English renders it "rejoice", and Korean follows.

decisions.choice: "위로를 받으십시오" (L); "격려를 받으십시오" (B); "힘을 내십시오" (R)
